segments.speaker: jal1628
segments.text: 5:32:20 JAL1628 Request three one zero. (i.e., 9449 m)

segments.speaker: aartcc
segments.text: 5:32:25 JAL1628 heavy, understand. Requesting flight level three one zero.

segments.speaker: aartcc
segments.text: 5:32:34 JAL1628 heavy, your transmissions are broken. Say again.

segments.speaker: aartcc
segments.text: 5:32:41 JAL1628 heavy, descend at pilot discretion. Maintain flight level three one zero.

segments.speaker: jal1628
segments.text: 5:32:45 Leaving three five zero to three one zero. (The descent begins)
